video_title: LaMelo Ball says he now has a driver and Lonzo trolls him 😂

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball questions his sons about their electric vehicle ownership
quotes.excerpt: Anybody got a electric car yet?

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Anybody got a electric car yet?

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: I have one, but they are not my main cars.

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I got a couple electric cars.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Do you have to plug them up all the time? How does that work?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: They damn near just sit on the charger.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball asks Lonzo Ball for his top five NBA guards
quotes.excerpt: Top five guards in the NBA?

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Top five guards in the NBA?

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Right now? I am going to say in general. Ever.

quotes.speaker: Lonzo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: Lonzo Ball lists his top five NBA guards of all time
quotes.excerpt: Magic. Steph. D-Rose. Penny. And Isaiah Thomas.

text_blocks.speaker: Lonzo Ball
text_blocks.text: Magic. Steph. D-Rose. Penny. And Isaiah Thomas.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: You consider Steph a guard? How? I am going to go with you, you are a shooter.

text_blocks.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Is this my top five though, or yours?

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Your top five. I did not know that. Go ahead, you know who your point guard is.

quotes.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LiAngelo Ball lists his top five NBA guards of all time
quotes.excerpt: I am going with Magic Johnson. I got Kyrie in there. I got Steph, Curry in there. That is three. I got Melo in there for real. And then D-Rose.

text_blocks.speaker: LiAngelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I am going with Magic Johnson. I got Kyrie in there. I got Steph, Curry in there. That is three. I got Melo in there for real. And then D-Rose.

text_blocks.speaker: LaVar Ball
text_blocks.text: Melo, you got that, man? Let me hear your guards.

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Five all-time guards? I don't watch enough basketball for all this. Steph Curry, Kyrie, Magic.
